title: Grand Theft Auto 6 30分钟预告片在Netflix首播
content:
Grand Theft Auto 6 30-minute teaser debuts on Netflix | GamesIndustry.biz
If you click on a link and make a purchase we may receive a small commission.
Read our editorial policy
.
Take-Two Interactive and Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto 6
extended gameplay debut
is
now live on Netflix
.
Netflix's website initially chugged a little under the strain when the half hour teaser went live at 8pm UK time but recovered soon after.
The teaser gave a taste of the hugely-anticipated story and combat, as well as the voice acting, the in-game world, vehicular play, the soundtrack (which includes Depeche Mode and a little Cliff Richard), and, notably, the return of six-star wanted levels.
It also appears that the game will feature more challenging car-jacking and an in-game relationship system, according to
IGN
.
Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick previously told
GamesIndustry.biz
this partnership
is merely "one of the hors d'oeuvres" of its marketing campaign for the game
, which launches on November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S.
Last week, a hacker group known as 'CyberLeek'
began leaking GTA 6 gameplay
, including mechanics, locations, and other assets. The group continues to threaten daily releases of new videos while promoting a memecoin. Take-Two, Rockstar's parent company,
subpoenaed Microsoft, Discord, and X
as part of its investigation into the source of the leaks.
Earlier this week,
Rockstar Games issued a statement regarding the recent leaks of Grand Theft Auto 6
. In a post shared on social media, the developer said it "would be an understatement to say [that this] has been heartbreaking for our team," and that it is "obviously not how we intended for you to see the game after all this time."
"We are very sorry that everything has taken as long as it has – from getting the game finished (nearly there) to sharing more details and official gameplay, and providing the community with everything you want to know."
